legend: After working for over a year in a corporation, Peter realised that this is not the way to get rich. Instead, he quit his job and decided to participate in a lottery.

The lottery consists of a bag of N$$$N$$$ prizes. The value of the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ prize is value[i]$$$value[i]$$$ and its weight is weight[i]$$$weight[i]$$$. A prize is chosen randomly from the bag according to its weight. That is, the probability of the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ prize to be chosen is weight[i]∑Nk=1weight[k]$$$\frac{weight[i]}{\sum_{k=1}^N weight[k]}$$$. Now, Peter has a choice to make. He can accept the prize and go home with it, or he can refuse the prize. If Peter refuses, the prize is placed back in the bag and Peter plays another round. However, Peter can refuse at most K$$$K$$$ times. If he refuses K$$$K$$$ times, then he is forced to take home the prize from the K+1th$$$K+1^{\text{th}}$$$ round.
Help Peter get rich and compute for him the maximum expected value he can get if he plays optimally.
input: The first line of the input contains the integers N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^5$$$) and K$$$K$$$ (0≤K≤107$$$0 \leq K \leq 10^7$$$), denoting the number of prizes in the bag and the maximum number of times Peter can refuse the prize.

Each of the following N$$$N$$$ lines contains 2$$$2$$$ integers value[i]$$$value[i]$$$ and weight[i]$$$weight[i]$$$ (1≤value[i],weight[i]≤105$$$1 \leq value[i], weight[i] \leq 10^5$$$), denoting the value and the weight of the ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ prize.
output: On a single line, print the maximum expected value Peter can get if he plays optimally. Your answer will be considered correct if the absolute or relative difference between your answer and judge's answer is less than 10−8$$$10^{-8}$$$.

legend.ai: 在公司工作了一年多后，Peter 意识到这并不是致富之道。于是，他辞去了工作，决定参加彩票。

请帮助 Peter 发财，并计算如果 Peter 采取最优策略，他能够获得的最大期望值。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 N$$$N$$$ (1≤N≤105$$$1 \leq N \leq 10^5$$$) 和 K$$$K$$$ (0≤K≤107$$$0 \leq K \leq 10^7$$$)，分别表示袋子中的奖品数量以及 Peter 最多可以拒绝奖品的次数。
接下来的 N$$$N$$$ 行中的每一行包含 2$$$2$$$ 个整数 value[i]$$$value[i]$$$ 和 weight[i]$$$weight[i]$$$ (1≤value[i],weight[i]≤105$$$1 \leq value[i], weight[i] \leq 10^5$$$)，分别表示第 ith$$$i^{\text{th}}$$$ 个奖品的价值和重量。

output.ai: 在一行中输出如果 Peter 采取最优策略所能获得的最大期望值。如果你的答案与标准答案之间的绝对误差或相对误差小于 10−8$$$10^{-8}$$$，则答案会被认为是正确的。
